signature: SUBROUTINE ZUNGBR( VECT, M, N, K, A, LDA, TAU, WORK, LWORK, INFO )

params.name: vect
M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix Q or $P^H$ to be returned. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix Q or $P^H$ to be returned. $N \ge 0$. If `VECT = 'Q'`, $M \ge N \ge \min (M,K)$; if `VECT = 'P'`, $N \ge M \ge \min (N,K)$.

params.name: K
params.reference: If `VECT = 'Q'`, the number of columns in the original M-by-K matrix reduced by ZGEBRD. If `VECT = 'P'`, the number of rows in the original K-by-N matrix reduced by ZGEBRD. $K \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the vectors which define the elementary reflectors, as returned by ZGEBRD. On exit, the M-by-N matrix Q or $P^H$.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge M$.

params.name: TAU

length.js: ( vect === 'apply-P' ) ? min( N, K ) : min( M, K )

params.reference: (min(N,K)) if `VECT = 'P'` `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i) or G(i), which determines Q or $P^H$, as returned by ZGEBRD in its array argument TAUQ or TAUP.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,\min (M,N))$. For optimum performance $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \min (M,N) \, \mathrm{NB}$, where NB is the optimal blocksize.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

checks.fortran: N.LT.0 .OR. ( WANTQ .AND. ( N.GT.M .OR. N.LT.MIN( M, K ) ) ) .OR. ( .NOT.WANTQ .AND. ( M.GT.N .OR. M.LT. MIN( N, K ) ) )
checks.js: (N < 0 || (vect === 'apply-Q' && (N > M || N < min( M, K )))) || (vect !== 'apply-Q' && (M > N || M < min( N, K )))
